judgment.rationale: First is a PRIMARY ONE Addition objective ('add 2-digit whole numbers with sum not greater than 40 without exchanging or renaming'); second is a PRIMARY ONE Subtraction objective ('subtract from whole numbers not greater than 18'). Both sit under the same Theme/Sub-Theme (Basic Operations) but in different topics (Addition vs Subtraction) at the same grade rank (0). Much of the flagged token/trigram overlap is boilerplate ('pupils should be able to', 'whole numbers not greater than'), which alone is not probative. However, addition and subtraction of whole numbers are complementary, mutually reinforcing inverse operations within Basic Operations, giving substantive conceptual coherence without a justified one-directional dependency. Same-rank status and parallel-topic placement provide no evidence that proficiency in one specifically enables the other, so buildsTowards is not warranted; relatesTo fits best.
